Based on the visual evidence provided:

**Width and Margins:**
The content **spans the full width of the viewport with reasonable margins**. It is not squeezed into a narrow centered column. The main container (the white card) extends almost to the edges of the 768px viewport, leaving only a small, consistent margin (likely around 16px–24px) on the left and right sides. The internal elements, such as text fields and the dashed-border container, utilize this full available width effectively.

**Overlapping or Cut-off Elements:**
Yes, there is **one clear instance of an overlapping element**:
*   A circular black badge containing the letter "**N**" is positioned on the far left edge of the screen. It overlaps the left border/margin of the main content card. This appears to be a floating UI element (possibly a notification or navigation trigger) that is not part of the standard document flow.

There are no other obvious cut-offs or overlapping elements within the main form area itself; all text and input fields appear fully visible and contained within their respective boundaries.
